summary: MaintCourseDetailsPlacementHistory is an ASP.NET Web UserControl for displaying the placement history of a course. It provides a GridView interface, data source management, and session-based selection logic for presenting placement-related data tied to a specific course.
purpose: To display and manage the placement history data for a given course in a web application, ensuring that only authorized session users can access and interact with the placement data.

fields.name: Label1
fields.description: A label for displaying text or titles.

fields.name: uxMaster
fields.description: Grid to display placement history entries, sorted by TTStartDate descending on initial load.

fields.name: dsMaster
fields.description: Data source control for fetching placement history data.

fields.name: UserSession
fields.description: Session object holding user and context information.

fields.name: CourseID
fields.description: The identifier for the course whose placement history is displayed.

workflows.name: Display Placement History
steps: If not a postback, uxMaster GridView is sorted by TTStartDate in descending order.
When dsMaster (ObjectDataSource) performs selection, check if UserSession exists.
If no UserSession, cancel data selection.
If UserSession exists, pass UserSession and CourseID as input parameters for data fetching.
Placement history data is fetched and rendered in uxMaster GridView.

business_rules: Placement history data can only be accessed if UserSession is valid.
Placement history is specific to the provided CourseID.
validations: UserSession presence is checked before data retrieval.
CourseID must be provided to retrieve relevant data.
calculations: GridView is sorted by TTStartDate in descending order upon initial page load.
conditions: Page load is not a postback
UserSession is null: cancel data selection
UserSession is present: allow data retrieval
system_behavior: Prevents selection of data if user is not authenticated or session has expired.
Automatically sorts placement history by start date latest-first on initial load.
exceptions: If UserSession is not set, ObjectDataSource selection is cancelled and data is not shown.
content_gaps: Business rules for data update, edit, or delete are not defined.
Details on which placement fields are displayed in uxMaster GridView are not provided.
No explicit description of what constitutes PlacementHistory data beyond StartDate sorting.
